simple.meaning: יֶקֶב (yeqeb) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a trough (as dug out); specifically, a wine- vat (whether the lower one, into which the juice drains; or the upper, in which the grapes are crushed).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Numbers 18:27. The surrounding context includes flock, offering, death.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יֶקֶב (H3342) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: יֶקֶב (yeqeb) / H3342 is traced through Numbers 18:27, Numbers 18:30, Deuteronomy 15:14, Deuteronomy 16:13 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: Your wave offering shall be credited to you, as though it were the grain of the threshing floor, and as the fullness of the wine press.
“Therefore you shall tell them, ‘When you heave its best from it, then it shall be credited to the Levites as the increase of the threshing floor, and as the increase of the wine press.
You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock, out of your threshing floor, and out of your wine press. As Yahweh your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.
You shall keep the feast of booths seven days, after you have gathered in from your threshing floor and from your wine press.

They took the two princes of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb. They killed Oreb at Oreb’s rock, and Zeeb they killed at Zeeb’s wine press, as they pursued Midian. Then they brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon beyond the Jordan.
He said, “If Yahweh doesn’t help you, where could I get help for you? From of the threshing floor, or from the wine press?”
They make oil within the walls of these men.
so your barns will be filled with plenty,

Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.
Gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field
The threshing floor and the wine press won’t feed them,
The threshing floors will be full of wheat,
Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty, there were only twenty.

All the land will be made like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will be lifted up, and will dwell in her place, from Benjamin’s gate to the place of the first gate, to the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananel to the king’s wine presses.

definitions.short: a trough (as dug out); specifically, a wine- vat (whether the lower one, into which the juice drains; or the upper, in which the grapes are crushed)
definitions.full: H3342. yeqeb יֶ֫קֶב noun masculine Prov 3:10 wine-vat (a trough or hollow excavated ( חצב Isa 5:2 ) in the rock for receiving the juice trodden out in the גַּת : Benz 212f. ), sometimes also wine-press (the trough in which the grapes were trodden out); — absolute יֶ֫קֶב 5:2 4 t.; יָ֑קֶב Num 18:30 ; construct י֫קֶב ֶ Judg 7:25 ; suffix יִקְבֶ֑ךָ Deut 15:14 ; 16:13 ; plural יְקָבִּים Job 24:11 4 t.; יִקְבֵּי Zech 14:10 ; יְקָבֶיךָ Prov 3:10 ; — wine- vat , Isa 5:2 ; Hag 2:16 ; Joel 4:13 (|| גַּת ), Prov 3:10 ; often || גֹּרֶן , Num 18:27 , 30 ; Deut 15:14 ; 16:13 ; 2Kin 6:27 ; Hosea 9:2 ; Joel 2:24 ; apparently of the wine-press Job 24:11 דָּֽרְכוּ יְקָבִים , Isa 16:10 n (hence Jer 48:33 ). Designating particular localities, Judg 7:25 זְאֵב יֶקֶב , Zech 14:10 הַמֶּלֶךְ יִקְבֵי (near Jerusalem). יְקַבְצְאֵל see below קבץ .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to excavate ;
